{{Quote|I personally favor a little chaos. It reminds me of the savage and beautiful Mother Jungle of home.|Hoolar Freeb|<ref name="SWG:HE" />}}
'''Hoolar Freeb''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] who lived at the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. She was a member of the [[Azure Cabal]], a mercenary group lead by [[Loruna Scathe]].<ref name="SWG:HE" />

Scathe placed Hoolar in charge of the Cabal's operations against [[Frosch Industries]], a biomedical company based in [[Kor Vella/Legends|Kor Vella]] on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]].<ref name="SWG:HE" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Hoolar Freeb appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:HE" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Hoolar Freeb was added to the game as part of the [[W:c:swg:Azure Cabal|Azure Cabal questline]],<ref name="SWG:HE" /> released with the "[[W:c:swg:Chapter 6 Notes for May 22 2007|Chapter 6]]" update, on [[May 22]], [[2007]].<ref name="Chapter 6">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=67250&month=052007|text=Publish Notes &ndash; Chapter 6: Masters of the Wild}}</ref>
